entries.toelichting: Multiple Levites and post-exilic figures (1Chr 9:35; 11:44; 15:18,20; 16:5; 23:8; 27:32; 29:8; 2Chr 21:2; 29:14; 31:13; 35:8; Ezr 8:9; 10:2,21,26). English convention: Jehiel. 'Mighty-One-lives'.
Levite of Merari's sons (1Chr 24:26,27). English convention: Jaaziah. 'YHWH-strengthens'.
Sole, only (Gen 22:2,12,16 'your-only-son-Isaac'; Judg 11:34 'his-only-daughter'; Ps 22:20; 25:16; 35:17; 68:6; Prov 4:3; Jer 6:26; Amos 8:10; Zech 12:10). Hyphenated.
Doorkeeper for the ark (1Chr 15:24). English convention: Jehiah. 'YHWH-lives'.
Son of Zebulun (Gen 46:14; Num 26:26). English convention: Jahleel.
Gentilic of Jahleel (Num 26:26). English convention: Jahleelite.
Son of Naphtali (Gen 46:24; Num 26:48). English convention: Jahzeel.
Gentilic of Jahzeel (Num 26:48). English convention: Jahzeelite.
Variant of Jahzeel (1Chr 7:13). English convention: Jahziel.
Pi: tarry beyond time (Gen 32:4 ketib variant). Hyphenated.
Hithp: enroll in genealogy (1Chr 5:1,7,17; 7:5,7,9,40; 9:1,22; 2Chr 12:15; 31:16-19; Ezr 2:62; 8:1,3; Neh 7:5,64). Hyphenated.
Multiple Levites and Judahites (1Chr 4:2; 6:20,43; 23:10,11; 24:22; 2Chr 34:12). English convention: Jahath.
Wilderness camp (Num 33:33,34; Deut 10:7). English convention: Jotbathah.
Levitical city of Judah (Josh 15:55; 21:16). English convention: Juttah.
Son of Ishmael (Gen 25:15; 1Chr 1:31; 5:19). English convention: Jetur.
Right pillar of temple, also persons (Gen 46:10; Ex 6:15; Num 26:12; 1Chr 9:10; 24:17; 2Chr 3:17; Neh 11:10). English convention: Jachin. 'He-establishes'.
Gentilic of Jachin (Num 26:12). English convention: Jachinite.
Mother of Uzziah (2Kgs 15:2; 2Chr 26:3). English convention: Jecoliah. 'YHWH-prevails'.
Variant of Jehoiachin (1Chr 3:16,17; Esth 2:6; Jer 24:1; 27:20; 28:4; 29:2; 37:1). English convention: Jeconiah. 'YHWH-establishes'.
Born-in-house, native (Gen 14:14; 17:12,13,23,27; Lev 18:9; Num 13:22,28; 2Sam 21:16,18; 1Chr 20:4,6,8; Jer 2:14). Hyphenated.

Qal/Pi/Hi/Hithp: walk, go, depart, proceed (~1,544 occurrences spanning all OT books — virtually every narrative passage uses it). Standard concordant covering literal walking, departing, journeying, and figurative going.
Isa 15:8; Jer 25:36; Zeph 1:10; Zech 11:3. Standard concordant.
Stage of locust (Ps 105:34; Jer 51:14,27; Joel 1:4; 2:25; Nah 3:15,16). Hyphenated.
Son of Simeon (Gen 46:10; Ex 6:15). English convention: Jemuel.
Daughter of Job (Job 42:14). English convention: Jemimah.
Son of Simeon and others (Gen 46:10; Ex 6:15; Num 26:12; 1Chr 2:27; 4:24; Neh 8:7). English convention: Jamin.
Gentilic of Jamin (Num 26:12). English convention: Jaminite.
Father of Micaiah (1Kgs 22:8,9; 2Chr 18:7,8). English convention: Imlah.
Asherite and others (Gen 46:17; Num 26:44; 1Chr 7:30; 2Chr 31:14). English convention: Imnah.
Adjective: pertaining to right (Ex 29:20; Lev 8:23; 14:14,17,25,28; 1Kgs 7:39; Eze 4:6). Hyphenated.
Town in Naphtali (2Kgs 15:29). English convention: Janoah.
Hill-town of Judah (Josh 15:53). English convention: Janim.
Daughter of Haran (Gen 11:29). English convention: Iscah.
Ash-scoop for altar (Ex 27:3; 38:3; Num 4:14; 1Kgs 7:40,45; 2Kgs 25:14; 2Chr 4:11,16; Jer 52:18). Standard concordant.
Judahite and place (1Chr 2:55; 4:9,10). English convention: Jabez.
Levite singer of Asaph's line (1Chr 6:21). Hyphenated.
Multiple Levites (1Chr 9:6; 2Chr 29:13; Ezr 8:13). English convention: Jeuel.
Multiple persons including Esau's son (Gen 36:5,14,18; 1Chr 1:35; 7:10; 8:39; 23:10,11; 2Chr 11:19). English convention: Jeush.
Town in Gad (Num 21:32; 32:1,3,35; Josh 13:25; 21:39; 2Sam 24:5; 1Chr 6:81; 26:31; Isa 16:8,9; Jer 48:32). English convention: Jazer.
Multiple persons (1Chr 5:7; 8:29; 9:35; 11:44; 15:18,21; 16:5; 2Chr 20:14; 26:11; 29:13; 35:9; Ezr 8:13; 10:43). English convention: Jeiel. 'Mighty-One-snatches-away'.
Wife of Heber, slayer of Sisera (Judg 4:17,18,21,22; 5:6,24). English convention: Jael.
Solomon's-servants ancestor (Ezr 2:56; Neh 7:58). English convention: Jaalah.
Female ostrich (Lev 11:16; Deut 14:15; Job 30:29; Isa 13:21; 34:13; 43:20; Jer 50:39; Mic 1:8). Standard concordant.
Qal/Hophal: be-faint (Judg 4:21; 1Sam 14:28,31; 2Sam 21:15; Isa 40:28,31; 44:12; 50:4; Jer 2:24; Hab 2:13). Hyphenated.
Patriarch (~349 occurrences in Genesis-Malachi). English convention: Jacob. 'Heel-grabber/Supplanter'.
Father of Elhanan (2Sam 21:19). Hyphenated. English convention: Jaare-oregim.
Qal/Pi/Pu/Hithp: be-fair, become-beautiful (Ps 45:2; Song 4:10; 7:1,6; Jer 4:30; 10:4; Eze 16:13; 31:7). Hyphenated.
Coastal city (Josh 19:46; 2Chr 2:16; Ezr 3:7; Jonah 1:3). English convention: Joppa.
Amorite king and David's son and Zebulun-border (Josh 10:3; 19:12; 2Sam 5:15; 1Chr 3:7; 14:6). English convention: Japhia.
Father of Caleb and Asherite (Num 13:6; 14:6,30,38; 26:65; 32:12; 34:19; Deut 1:36; Josh 14:6,13,14; 15:13; 21:12; Judg 1:12; 1Chr 4:15; 6:56; 7:38). English convention: Jephunneh.
Son of Noah (Gen 5:32; 6:10; 7:13; 9:18,23,27; 10:1,2,21; 1Chr 1:4,5). English convention: Japheth.
Hi/Hophal: place, set-down (Gen 30:38; 33:15; 43:9; 47:2; Ex 10:24; Deut 28:56; Judg 6:37; 7:5; 8:27; 1Sam 5:2; 2Sam 6:17; Job 17:6; Jer 51:34; Hos 2:3,10). Hyphenated.
Gentilic of Izhar (Num 3:27; 1Chr 24:22; 26:23,29). English convention: Izharite.
Hi/Hophal: lay-bed, spread-out (Isa 14:11; 58:5; Ps 139:8; Esth 4:3). Hyphenated.

What-is-shaped, mental-formation, inclination (Gen 6:5; 8:21; Deut 31:21; 1Chr 28:9; 29:18; Ps 103:14; Isa 26:3; 29:16; Hab 2:18). Hyphenated to mark thought-or-product-formed; key to 'inclination-of-thoughts' (Gen 6:5).
Son of Naphtali (Gen 46:24; Num 26:49; 1Chr 7:13). English convention: Jezer.
Wine-press receiving-vat (Num 18:27,30; Deut 15:14; Judg 7:25; 2Kgs 6:27; Job 24:11; Prov 3:10; Isa 5:2; 16:10; Jer 48:33; Hos 9:2; Joel 2:24; 3:13; Hag 2:16; Zech 14:10). Hyphenated.
Town in Judah (Neh 11:25). English convention: Jekabzeel.
Qal/Hophal: be-kindled, kept-burning (Lev 6:9,12,13; Deut 32:22; Isa 10:16; 65:5; Jer 15:14; 17:4). Hyphenated.
Father of Agur (Prov 30:1). English convention: Jakeh.
Son of Eber (Gen 10:25,26,29; 1Chr 1:19,20,23). English convention: Joktan.
Benjamite and priest (1Chr 8:19; 24:12). English convention: Jakim.
Jerahmeelite and son of Jeconiah (1Chr 2:41; 3:18). English convention: Jekamiah. 'YHWH-raises'.
Qal/Hi/Hophal: be-disjointed, hang (Gen 32:25; Num 25:4; 2Sam 21:6,9,13; Jer 6:8). Hyphenated.
Qal/Hi: be-valuable, costly (1Sam 18:30; 26:21; 2Kgs 1:13,14; Ps 49:8; 72:14; 116:15; 139:17; Prov 25:17; Isa 13:12). Hyphenated.
Son of Abraham by Keturah (Gen 25:2,3; 1Chr 1:32). English convention: Jokshan.
Place in Judah and Edom (Josh 15:38; 2Kgs 14:7). English convention: Joktheel.
Gideon's other name (Judg 6:32; 7:1; 8:29,35; 9:1,2,5,16,19,24,28,57; 1Sam 12:11). English convention: Jerubbaal. 'Let-Baal-contend'.
Wilderness near Tekoa (2Chr 20:16). English convention: Jeruel.
Mother of Jotham (2Kgs 15:33; 2Chr 27:1). English convention: Jerushah. 'Possessed-married'.
Sacred city (~643 occurrences across Joshua-Malachi). English convention: Jerusalem. 'Foundation-of-peace'.
Lunar-month, period of moon (Ex 2:2; Deut 21:13; 33:14; 1Kgs 6:37,38; 8:2; 2Kgs 15:13; Job 3:6; 7:3; 29:2; 39:2; Zech 11:8). Hyphenated to distinguish from H2320 chodesh new-moon-cycle.
Son of Joktan (Gen 10:26; 1Chr 1:20). English convention: Jerah.
Multiple persons (1Sam 1:1; 1Chr 6:27,34; 8:27; 9:8,12; 12:7; 27:22; 2Chr 23:1; Neh 11:12). English convention: Jeroham.
Judahite and others (1Chr 2:9,25-27,33,42; 24:29; Jer 36:26). English convention: Jerahmeel. 'Mighty-One-has-mercy'.
Job 31:35; Ps 35:1; Isa 49:25; Jer 18:19. Standard concordant.
Multiple persons (1Chr 4:24; Ezr 8:16; 10:18). English convention: Jarib.
David's mighty man (1Chr 11:46). English convention: Jeribai.
Multiple persons (1Chr 7:7,8; 12:6; 24:30; 25:4,22; 27:19; 2Chr 11:18; 31:13; Ezr 10:26,27,29). English convention: Jerimoth.
Tabernacle-curtain or tent-fabric (Ex 26:1-13; 36:8-17; Num 4:25; 2Sam 7:2; 1Chr 17:1; Ps 104:2; Song 1:5; Isa 54:2; Jer 4:20; 10:20; 49:29; Hab 3:7). Hyphenated.
Wife of Caleb (1Chr 2:18). English convention: Jerioth.
